connection.name: Name

connection.authorizeKeyBody: Token hosts use this key over SSH to upload the cloud-init snippet. Add it to the token user's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on the Proxmox node.

account.title: How to connect
account.description: Choose how the launcher signs in to AWS.
account.billing: Labs run in your account and are billed while they run; the cost depends on each lab's size. Stopping a lab, or its auto-stop, destroys what it created.
account.cliNote: A profile or browser sign-in. No secret stored.
account.keysNote: An IAM user's key and secret.

descriptions.azure: Sign in with the Azure CLI, then pick your subscription and location.
descriptions.gcp: Sign in with the gcloud CLI, then pick a billing account. Labs run in one Cyber CTF labs project, created on the first test (it needs one free project slot on the billing account).
descriptions.token: Paste a {cloud} API token with read/write scope, and pick a region.
descriptions.oci: Uses ~/.oci/config (API signing key). Pick a compartment and region.
descriptions.awsCli: Pick a profile, or sign in with the browser.

credentials.ociMissing: No ~/.oci/config found. Set it up with `oci setup config` or from the console.
